run_dedup_km: run the process_km script with --dedup to deduplicate lines in a km file
run_remove_under_k_km: run the process_km script with --remove-under-k to remove tokens repeating less than k times
run_dedup_and_remove_under_k_km: run the process_km script with both --dedup and --remove-under-k flags on a km file
run_km_with_output_path: run the process_km script with --output to write the processed km file to a custom path
run_km_no_operation: run the process_km script without --dedup or --remove-under-k to see the nothing to do message
